scope: warm-color revision of seven existing design mockups; no production app changes

prompts.prompt:
Edit the FIRST attached image, an existing Pankeki desktop UI design. The SECOND image is the user's explicit warm-color style reference. This is a COLOR/SURFACE STYLE REVISION of the first screen, not a new layout or concept. Match the first image's original desktop viewport dimensions and aspect ratio, approximately 1440 x 1024. Return ONE full app screen, no device/browser frame, no collage or annotation.

Preserve the first image's screen structure, panel positions, readable Korean labels, controls, active stage, data, character artworks, pose, proportions and feature scope. Do not copy the reference's navigation, hero pancake banner, anime avatars, subscription/Pro upsell, fictional "Pankeki" model, character DNA, automatic detection or any new features. The user asks for the reference's WARM COLOR FEEL applied to the existing product. Keep the existing small pancake logo, use brown wordmark lettering; do not replace the logo.

Apply a coherent elegant palette inspired by reference image 2: ivory/cream page #F8F1E8, warm off-white panels #FFFCF8, lightly toasted canvas #F3EBE2, pale apricot selected rows #FFF0DB, warm borders #E8D9CA, deep cocoa text #4A2B1A and readable muted brown #786353. Replace cold blue UI selections, slider tracks, focus outlines, active navigation and buttons with honey/orange accents. Main actions use a deeper burnt-orange #B95416 with white text for legibility; small highlights can use lighter honey #E9A251. Selected rows pair pale apricot with burnt-orange text/underline. Keep non-selected icons neutral warm brown. Subtle soft warm shadows only; slightly soften panel corners to 10-12px where appropriate, keep dense editor controls compact. No sepia wash, orange filter, or desaturation over CHARACTER ARTWORK: the original blue-gray cloak, natural skin, desert image and intended glove colors remain intact. Colorful semantic masks and hue-control rainbow gradients must remain meaningful.

Aim for the reference's comfortable, welcoming, softly lit craft-studio feeling while keeping a precise professional editor. Don't inflate whitespace, add marketing headlines or remove useful controls. Body text stays readable (14px main, 12px supporting). Do not fill backgrounds with saturated orange, low-contrast beige text or white text on pale peach. No thick ornamental borders, glassmorphism or glowing gradients. Preserve status distinctions "기존", "개발 예정", "연결 예정", and "환경 복원 필요"; a design mock must never become proof of completed implementation. Discreet existing design-concept footer stays. Current date is 2026-10-20 Asia/Seoul; do not add dates or timestamps.
